sources.snippet: VIGOR-27B-GGUF VIGOR-27B (Vision Intelligence and Guardrail Oriented Reasoning) is a dense 27-billion-parameter multimodal vision classification model based on Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. It is designed for visual content-safety analysis and conservative Safe / NSFW classification, with a particular focus on identifying potentially sensitive, revealing, provocative, and sexually suggestive visual ...

sources.title: Nous Research releases Arete-27B to reduce Chinese AI propaganda
sources.snippet: Nous Research has released Arete-27B, a post-trained model built on a Qwen base that reduces a measured propaganda rate from 22% to 1% while maintaining general performance.
